question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
reference_answer: Use self-service reset at https://id.halcyon-dynamics.example/reset: enter your work email, verify with your registered MFA method and choose a new password. If you can't use self-service (e.g. no MFA enrolled), call the Service Desk on extension 4357 for an assisted reset.

question: How long does my new password have to be?
reference_answer: At least 14 characters.

question: My account got locked after I typed the wrong password a few times. What should I do?
reference_answer: The account locks for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts and unlocks automatically; no ticket is needed. Update old saved passwords (phone, mapped drives) to avoid repeat lockouts.

question: Can I use SMS text messages as my MFA method?
reference_answer: No. SMS (and voice calls) are not permitted because of SIM-swap attacks. Approved methods are Microsoft Authenticator push, a FIDO2 security key, or the Authenticator 6-digit code.

question: I lost the phone that has my Authenticator app. How can I sign in?
reference_answer: Call the Service Desk on extension 4357. After identity verification the analyst issues a Temporary Access Pass valid for 8 hours so you can register a new method.

question: How do I connect to the VPN on my Windows laptop?
reference_answer: Open SecureLink from the system tray (or Start > SecureLink), check the gateway is vpn.halcyon-dynamics.example, click Connect, sign in with your Halcyon ID and approve the MFA prompt. The shield turns green when connected.

question: SecureLink says 'gateway unreachable' when I'm in a hotel. What can I do?
reference_answer: Usually a captive portal or a firewall blocking UDP 4501: open a browser to accept the hotel Wi-Fi portal, then try the fallback gateway vpn-tcp.halcyon-dynamics.example.

question: My VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes on my MacBook. Is there a fix?
reference_answer: Known issue KI-0007 (macOS 15 with SecureLink 6.2/6.3). Workaround: switch SecureLink's protocol from Auto to TCP (most users say this alone fixes it), and adjust battery settings (prevent automatic sleeping on power adapter, turn off Power Nap). A vendor fix is expected in SecureLink 6.4.

question: Can I connect my personal laptop to the company VPN?
reference_answer: No. Only company-managed devices may connect to the VPN.

question: Nobody can hear me in Teams calls when my ThinkPad is on the docking station.
reference_answer: Known issue KI-0012: Windows picks the dock's audio as default. In Teams, go to Settings > Device settings and choose your headset explicitly as speaker and microphone; make it the Windows default in Settings > System > Sound; if it isn't listed, unplug the dock for 10 seconds and plug it back in.

question: Outlook is stuck on 'Loading Profile'. How do I fix it?
reference_answer: Close Outlook fully, start it in safe mode (Windows + R, outlook.exe /safe). If safe mode works, disable recently added COM add-ins; if it also fails, create a new mail profile in Control Panel > Mail and make it the default.

question: What is the maximum size of an email I can send?
reference_answer: 35 MB including attachments; larger messages are rejected, so share large files with a OneDrive link.

question: How big is my mailbox, and what happens when it fills up?
reference_answer: Standard mailboxes have a 100 GB quota. At 98% full you can no longer send email. Free space by emptying Deleted Items and Junk, finding large items, or enabling the online archive (an extra 100 GB).

question: Can I read my work email in the iPhone Mail app?
reference_answer: No. Only the Outlook mobile app is supported on phones; native mail apps such as iOS Mail are blocked by policy.

question: How do I add the office printer on my Mac?
reference_answer: System Settings > Printers & Scanners > Add Printer, IP tab: address print01.halcyon-dynamics.example, protocol LPD, queue HD-FollowMe, driver Generic PostScript.

question: How many colour pages am I allowed to print per month?
reference_answer: 200 colour pages per month per person, unless your manager approves more.

question: How do I get a new laptop, and how long does delivery take?
reference_answer: Request it in the Service Desk portal under Hardware > Laptop Request (business justification needed for Power and Mac models); your manager approves; standard models are delivered within 5 business days of approval.

question: How often do laptops get replaced?
reference_answer: Every 4 years. You're contacted automatically about 30 days before the refresh date, so no request is needed.

question: My work laptop was stolen from my car. What do I need to do?
reference_answer: Report it immediately by phone on extension 4357 so it can be remotely locked and wiped, then file a report in the portal under Security > Lost or Stolen Device. Theft must also be reported to the police and the crime reference number added to the ticket. It's treated as a security incident.

question: How do I install Zoom on my work laptop?
reference_answer: Open the Company Portal app, search for Zoom and click Install; no admin rights are needed. Installation usually finishes within 15 minutes.

question: How do I request software that isn't in the Company Portal, and how long does approval take?
reference_answer: Raise a request under Software > New Software Request with the name, vendor, version, business justification and licence needs. The Security team reviews it within up to 10 business days; paid software also needs a cost centre and manager approval.

question: Can I get admin rights on my laptop?
reference_answer: Standard users don't have local admin rights. Developers and IT staff can request just-in-time elevation through the Company Portal (Request Admin Elevation), which lasts 60 minutes, needs a reason and is logged.

question: Which Wi-Fi network should I use for my personal phone in the office?
reference_answer: Halcyon-BYOD: sign in with your Halcyon ID and approve MFA. It gives internet and Microsoft 365 only (no internal systems); up to 3 personal devices per person.

question: My company laptop won't connect to the office Wi-Fi.
reference_answer: Turn Wi-Fi off and on, then restart the laptop in the office so its device certificate renews. If it has been away from the office and off the VPN for more than 90 days the certificate may have expired: connect with a network cable or the VPN once, then restart.

question: How do I get access to the Finance shared drive?
reference_answer: Request it in the portal under Access > Shared Drive Access with the folder path, Read or Read/Write, and a business reason. The data owner approves; access is granted within 2 business days of approval.

question: I'm starting next week. What do I need to do in my first week for IT?
reference_answer: Change your temporary password (14+ characters), enrol in MFA within 7 days, complete Security Awareness training within 14 days, accept the Acceptable Use Policy, install role software from the Company Portal and request shared drive access.

question: When is a leaver's account switched off?
reference_answer: At 17:00 local time on the last working day. For immediate terminations the manager or HR phones extension 4357 and the account is disabled within 1 hour.

question: What are the response and resolution targets for a P2 incident?
reference_answer: First response within 30 minutes, resolution within 8 hours, 24x7, with updates every 2 hours.

question: How should I report a P1 incident?
reference_answer: By phone on extension 4357 so the on-call engineer is paged immediately; don't rely on a portal ticket or email alone.

question: Am I allowed to paste customer data into ChatGPT to summarise it?
reference_answer: No. Confidential or Restricted data, customer personal data and source code must never be entered into public AI chatbots; only AI tools approved by Security and listed in the Company Portal may be used with company data.

question: What are the data classification levels?
reference_answer: Four levels: Public, Internal (the default), Confidential and Restricted.

question: Can I email a Restricted document to a partner company?
reference_answer: No. Restricted data must not be sent by email, and must never be shared externally without approval from the Chief Information Security Officer.

question: Can I get a second monitor for working from home?
reference_answer: The standard home kit is one 27-inch monitor and a docking station. A second monitor is non-standard: it needs a workplace assessment and manager approval.

question: Does the company pay for my home broadband?
reference_answer: No, home broadband costs are not reimbursed.

question: When is the walk-up IT desk open?
reference_answer: On the ground floor of each office, 08:30 to 17:30 on weekdays.
